{{Quote|The remote turrets will finish them off!|[[Gorgol/Legends|Gorgol]]|translated=1|<ref name="The Droid Deception">{{TCWComicCite|6.4|The Droid Deception}}</ref>}}
An '''autoturret''' was a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] turret emplacement used to defend an area. Known for their killing power and effectiveness, they were employed by many factions throughout galactic history.

==History==
[[File:Clonesniperturret.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Clone sharpshooter/Legends|Clone sniper]] using an autoturret for cover.]]
Autoturrets were used widely during the [[Jedi Civil War]], with the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] deploying them to restrict access to the [[Undercity (Taris)|Undercity]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and to defend their military bases. Often, they were installed at the entrances to hidden bases, onboard [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], or near personal valuables.<ref name="kotor1">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

During the [[First Jedi Purge]], the fortified base of [[Khoonda]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] utilized them.<ref name="kotor 2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

Flying autoturrets were a variety of [[skytrooper]] droids in use by [[Zakuul]] [[Eternal Empire military|military]].<ref name="kotfe">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>

In the later stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], portable autoturrets were used by both the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] for covering fire or to reinforce the defense of field command posts. These autoturrets became the standard equipment of [[Clone sharpshooter/Legends|clone]] and [[Battle droid assassin|droid snipers]], who were entrusted with their deployment.<ref name="BF2">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>
